name: VictoriaMetrics
description: VictoriaMetrics is a fast, cost-effective and scalable open-source time series database and monitoring solution designed to handle high volumes of metrics data with minimal resource usage.

notes.text: VictoriaMetrics has no built-in authentication. Use a reverse proxy with authentication for production deployments.
Data is stored in /opt/victoriametrics_data and persists across updates.
This is the single-node version. For cluster deployments, see VictoriaMetrics Cluster documentation.
